slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
deeply informed

history on your walk

listen to one history podcast episode on your way to work. after a month you'll know the stories behind wars, empires and inventions most people only know by name.

historical novels

read one historical novel a month set in a time you know nothing about. a good story makes a whole era stick in your head far better than any list of dates ever did.

your town's past

once a month, visit one historic place near where you live and learn its story. your own town is full of history that almost nobody around you knows anymore.

this day in history

spend 5 minutes a day learning what happened on this day in history. one small story a day builds a timeline in your head that makes the news much easier to understand.

slides.texte_overlay:
old maps

look at an old map of your city or country once a week and compare it to today. borders, streets and names all change, and watching it happen makes history feel real.
